title: SCP-4230, The Snowman
description: An anomalous snowman that inflicts a deadly effect, spawning snowy corpses and aggressive mini-snowmen.
body:
The Snowman adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-4230, also known as the The Snowman or It's a christmas miracle.


SCP-4230 appears as an immobile snowman made from dirt, snow and leaves. It spawns during night in snowy biomes and gives the anomalous SCP-4230-1 effect to nearby players and villagers. This effect grows stronger in stages, eventually freezing and killing the victim. Those who die while affected leave behind an SCP-4230-A corpse, which in turn can spawn SCP-4230-B Instances that only live for a short time but relentlessly attack anything nearby.

<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-4230 spawn?

SCP-4230 can spawn on the overworld surface like a normal monster in cold biomes. However, there can only one instances of SCP-4230.

► What does SCP-4230-1 Infection do?

SCP-4230-1 is a new effect given by SCP-4230.

Stage 0:

Nothing will happen


Stage 1:

Take 1 Damage With 0.08%

Gain Slowness 2

Gain Weakness 1

Gain Mining Fatique 1


Stage 2:

Take 2 Damage With 1%

Freezes Victim

Gain Slowness 3

Gain Weakness 1

Gain Mining Fatique 1


Die with SCP-4230-1:

SCP-4230-A spawns
</details>



![SCP-4230](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/650f8fa19470e6f96f7bee6114791080408e0604.png)

SCP-4230 is an immobile snowman made from dirt, snow and leaves. It spawns on the surface of snowy biomes during nighttime. It never melts, even in fire and never moves. Every player within twelve blocks is immediately afflicted with the SCP-4230-1 effect, and SCP-4230 will look in the direction of the nearest player. Villagers can be infected as well. The effect progresses through multiple stages, beginning harmlessly before inflicting weakness, slowness, and mining fatigue, eventually advancing to freezing damage. If a player dies while under the influence of SCP-4230-1, SCP-4230 transforms their body into an instance of SCP-4230-A.
